categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Yunlu Advanced Materials Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the design, research, production, and sales of advanced magnetic metal materials. Its main product lines include amorphous alloys, nanocrystalline alloys, and magnetic powders and their products, such as amorphous alloy thin strips and cores, nanocrystalline ultra-thin strips, atomized and crushed powders, and magnetic powder cores. These products are primarily applied in power distribution, new energy vehicles, 5G infrastructure, rail transit, data centers, consumer electronics, home appliances, and heavy ion scientific research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as small-flow melt precision continuous casting, extreme cooling control, composition design and system evaluation, high-temperature electromagnetic oxidation metallurgy, and extreme cooling atomization. These enable the production of high-quality amorphous and nanocrystalline alloy thin strips with precise thickness and width control, as well as magnetic powders. It also developed industrialized technology for amorphous three-dimensional wound cores, improving transformer safety, noise reduction, and performance consistency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include power grid companies, electrical equipment manufacturers, and producers of transformers and electronic devices. The company serves domestic and international markets, with products sold to over 30 countries including India, South Korea, and Vietnam. End markets span power distribution, photovoltaic, new energy vehicles, rail transit, data centers, home appliances, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Qingdao, Shandong Province. It has expanded its international presence with sales in over 30 countries across Southeast Asia, South Asia, and North America. It also established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Shenzhen to enhance rapid response and technology development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunlu operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the magnetic materials supply chain. It produces core raw materials like amorphous and nanocrystalline alloy strips and magnetic powders, and extends downstream into finished products such as amorphous cores and transformer components, providing integrated solutions along the full industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in advanced soft magnetic materials, focusing on green, energy-efficient products aligned with carbon neutrality goals. It invests heavily in R&D, with a 19.17% increase in spending in 2024, and maintains a strong patent portfolio including over 30 global PCT patents. Strategic R&D projects target high-performance amorphous and nanocrystalline materials, magnetic powder cores, and applications in new energy vehicles, photovoltaics, and power electronics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of advanced magnetic materials and related products, including amorphous alloy strips, nanocrystalline products, and magnetic powders. The company also earns income from technical services and government subsidies. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts with industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunlu is a leading domestic player and the largest supplier of amorphous alloy thin strips in China, with a designed annual capacity of 105,000 tons. It holds a dominant market share domestically and is expanding internationally. The company is recognized as a national-level technology center and a specialized 'little giant' enterprise, positioning itself as a global provider of sustainable energy materials and integrated solutions in the magnetic materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.9 billion, a 7.24% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 361 million, up 8.73%. Total assets reached RMB 3.14 billion, growing 12.53% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong cash dividend payout ratio of over 30% of net profit and continues to invest significantly in R&D, reflecting a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunlu emphasizes its advanced manufacturing technologies that produce high-performance, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly soft magnetic materials with superior properties such as low coercivity, high magnetic permeability, and high electrical resistivity. Its products enable significant energy savings and carbon emission reductions across their lifecycle. The company’s integrated industry chain capabilities and global patent portfolio provide competitive advantages in delivering customized, high-quality solutions for diverse high-end applications.
